title: Learn
lede: Five real, checked messages a day. Practice telling a scam from a genuine one before it reaches you for real.

rule.title: Rule of thumb
rule.body: A real bank, courier or government office never asks you to pay a fee, share an OTP, or move money urgently over SMS, WhatsApp or a call. When a message pushes you to act fast and stay quiet, stop and verify through the number on the official website — never the one in the message.
